Exercise 2 — Matching 
Match the words with their meanings: 
A B 
1. Remittances a. Emotional distress after moving to a new culture 
2. Brain drain b. Shortage of available jobs 
3. Overpopulation c. Movement of skilled people abroad 
4. Cultural shock d. Money sent home by migrants 
 
   Exercise 3 — Discussion / Writing Prompt 
Write a short paragraph (80–100 words) answering: 
   "Do you think migration has more positive or negative effects on a 
country? Explain why."
 
    Exercise 4 — Word Formation 
Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets. 
1. Many countries depend on __________ (migrate) labour to fill skill 
gaps in their workforce. 
2. The government introduced new __________ (integrate) programs to 
help newcomers adjust to local life. 
3. __________ (discriminate) against migrants can create social 
divisions and tension. 
4. The process of __________ (global) has made migration easier than 
ever before. 
5. Improving education and job opportunities can help reduce the 
__________ (depart) of skilled workers. 

 Exercise 5 — Collocations Practice 
Match the beginning of each phrase (Column A) with its correct ending 
(Column B): 
A B 
1. cultural a. opportunities 
2. economic b. barriers 
3. language c. society 
4. migrant d. diversity 
5. multicultural e. workers
